description: Frontend lab UI: typed lab API client, a 'My Labs' section on the labs page (keeping the curated static catalog as 'Curated Labs'), workspace Save/Save As/Open/New + lab loading via ?lab=, and dashboard lab count + recent labs. Depends on FEAT-001's API contract (fields: LabSummary without topology, Lab with {nodes, edges} topology, owner_name, 204 on delete). Build/type-check is independent of the running backend. Do not use framer-motion; keep the light theme.
steps: 1. Create apps/web/src/lib/lab-api.ts importing apiFetch from './api', DeviceNode from '@/lib/deviceTypes', Edge from '@xyflow/react'. Types: LabSummary {id,name,description,created_at,updated_at,device_count,link_count}; LabTopology {nodes: DeviceNode[]; edges: Edge[]}; Lab extends LabSummary {topology: LabTopology}. Functions: listLabs() GET '/labs/labs/' -> LabSummary[]; createLab({name,description?,topology}) POST '/labs/labs/' -> Lab; getLab(id) GET '/labs/labs/${id}/' -> Lab; updateLab(id, partial) PATCH '/labs/labs/${id}/' -> Lab; deleteLab(id) DELETE '/labs/labs/${id}/' -> void. Use apiFetch<T>(path,{method,body:JSON.stringify(...)}) like simulation-api.ts.

2. Convert apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/labs/page.tsx to a thin server component: keep export const metadata, the static LABS catalog, LabCard, DIFFICULTY_BADGE, TOPIC_ICON helpers, and the Curated Labs 'Available now'/'Coming soon' sections verbatim; insert <MyLabsSection /> after the page header.

3. Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/labs/MyLabsSection.tsx as a 'use client' component: useEffect calls listLabs(); tracks loading/error/labs; renders a 'My Labs' header with a Create New Lab button (<Link href='/labs/workspace'><Button>); a grid of cards (name, description, device_count, updated_at) each with Open (<Link href={`/labs/workspace?lab=${lab.id}`}>) and Delete (deleteLab(id) then refetch) buttons; loading skeleton; error message; empty state 'You haven't saved any labs yet. Build a topology in the workspace and click Save.' Use Card/Button/Badge from @/components/ui and light-theme CSS vars.

4. Create apps/web/src/components/labs/workspace/SaveLabDialog.tsx ('use client') modeled on NodeConfigPopup.tsx: overlay + centered 320px modal, Name field (required, autofocus), Description textarea, Save (green, disabled when name empty) + Cancel, Enter to save / Esc to close. Props {mode:'save'|'saveAs'; initialName?; initialDescription?; onSubmit:(name,description)=>void; onClose:()=>void}. Same inline-style light theme.

5. Modify apps/web/src/components/labs/workspace/WorkspaceToolbar.tsx: add props currentLabName:string|null, onSave, onSaveAs, onOpen, onNew, saving?:boolean; render (currentLabName ?? 'Untitled Lab') instead of hardcoded 'Untitled Lab'; add a divider + Save/Save As/Open/New buttons (lucide Save, FolderOpen, FilePlus2) using the existing Btn helper style. Keep Start/Stop/Wipe/Clear unchanged.

6. Modify apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/labs/workspace/page.tsx: add state currentLabId/currentLabName/saveDialog; import use useRouter from next/navigation and getLab/createLab/updateLab from @/lib/lab-api. On mount read new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('lab'); if it matches /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i call getLab(id), setNodes(lab.topology.nodes)/setEdges(lab.topology.edges)/bumpCounter, set currentLabId+currentLabName, skip the sessionStorage load for that render; on error fall back to the existing sessionStorage load. handleSave({name,description}) builds topology={nodes,edges}; if mode==='save' && currentLabId updateLab(currentLabId,{name,description,topology}) else createLab({name,description,topology}); set currentLabId/currentLabName from response, close dialog, store currentLabId in sessionStorage (key netlab_current_lab). handleSaveAs opens dialog mode 'saveAs'. handleOpen router.push('/labs'). handleNew clears canvas + currentLabId/currentLabName + sessionStorage keys + handleWipe. Render <SaveLabDialog> when saveDialog.open.

7. Convert apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx to a thin server component: keep export const metadata, render <DashboardClient />. Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/DashboardClient.tsx ('use client'): useEffect calls listLabs(); 4-stat row with 'Labs completed' replaced by 'My Labs' = fetched count (other three stay '—'); replace the empty 'Recent activity' card with a 'Recent Labs' card listing labs.slice(0,3) as <Link href={`/labs/workspace?lab=${lab.id}`}> rows (name + updated_at) with empty state 'No saved labs yet.'; add a 'Create New Lab' quick link (<Link href='/labs/workspace'>) to 'Jump to'. Move EmptyState/QuickLink helpers into this client file. Keep light theme; no framer-motion.
acceptance_criteria: cd apps/web && npm run build succeeds (type-check + production build)
apps/web/src/lib/lab-api.ts exports listLabs/createLab/getLab/updateLab/deleteLab and Lab/LabSummary/LabTopology types matching the backend contract
labs page renders the static Curated Labs catalog unchanged AND a 'My Labs' section (client) that fetches listLabs and handles loading/error/empty
workspace: ?lab=<uuid> loads the saved topology into the canvas; Save creates/updates a lab; Save As always creates new; Open navigates to /labs; New clears the canvas; the toolbar shows the lab name
dashboard shows 'My Labs: <count>', a Recent Labs card (3 most recent), and a Create New Lab quick link
No framer-motion usage added; simulation endpoints and curated catalog untouched
findings: Dependency: FEAT-001 must land first so the /api/v1/labs/labs/ endpoints exist for runtime. The frontend type-check/build does not require the backend to be running, but the contract (field names, topology shape {nodes, edges}, 204 on delete, owner_name on detail) must match FEAT-001 exactly.
